subject.title: [Feature]: Add $EDITOR compose mode in TUI (external editor handoff) for multiline prompts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core TUI external-editor compose handoff now, and what trigger plus guardrails should govern VISUAL/EDITOR process launch and temporary prompt contents?
rationale: The requested feature is coherent and still missing, but it intentionally executes a local process and persists prompt text outside the in-memory composer, so automation should not choose the UX or security boundary alone.

options.title: Approve Bounded Core Flow
options.body: Implement the TUI handoff with a chosen shortcut or slash command, no auto-submit, explicit status/errors, temp-file cleanup expectations, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Require Design First
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers settle shortcut conflicts, privacy wording, and whether the flow is keybinding-only or slash-command addressable.

options.title: Defer External Editor
options.body: Leave long-prompt work to inline multiline or web composer improvements and decline the local editor process handoff for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Core Flow
recommendation.body: Implement the TUI handoff with a chosen shortcut or slash command, no auto-submit, explicit status/errors, temp-file cleanup expectations, docs, and focused tests.
